techniques.name: Bandeja
techniques.summary: Defensive overhead from the net area: sideways, racket high, wrist cocked, a controlled slice across the ball to keep the net. Same racket path as versions 1 to 4, now held in a continental grip.

phases.name: ready
phases.label: Ready
phases.cue: Racket up at chest height, free hand on the throat

phases.name: preparation
phases.label: Preparation
phases.cue: Turn sideways early, lift the racket

phases.name: backswing
phases.label: Backswing
phases.cue: Racket above the head, elbow about 90°, wrist cocked

phases.name: forward_swing
phases.label: Forward swing
phases.cue: Descending path, out and across, not a smash

phases.name: contact
phases.label: Contact
phases.cue: Meet the ball in front, arm extending, wrist firm

phases.name: follow_through
phases.label: Follow through
phases.cue: Keep travelling across to a wrapped finish

phases.name: recovery
phases.label: Recovery
phases.cue: Use the momentum, step back in to the net

techniques.name: Víbora
techniques.summary: Aggressive overhead with heavy side-slice: contact to the right of the head, the racket cuts round the side of the ball so it skids low off the side glass.

phases.name: preparation
phases.label: Turn and point
phases.cue: Turn sideways, point at the ball

phases.name: contact
phases.label: Contact
phases.cue: Hit beside the head, cut round the side

phases.name: follow_through
phases.label: Follow-through
phases.cue: Swing across and down to the left

phases.name: finish
phases.label: Finish
phases.cue: Finish low on the left side

techniques.name: Flat smash
techniques.summary: Full overhead to finish the point: racket drop behind the back, full extension, contact high and in front, ball driven down hard.

phases.name: preparation
phases.label: Turn and point
phases.cue: Turn sideways, point at the lob

phases.name: racket_drop
phases.label: Racket drop
phases.cue: Deep racket drop behind the back

phases.name: contact
phases.label: Contact
phases.cue: Full reach, contact high and in front

techniques.name: Smash por tres (x3)
techniques.summary: Power smash hit flat and steeply down so the ball rebounds high off the floor and over the opponents' back wall.

phases.name: contact
phases.label: Contact
phases.cue: Hit on top of the ball, flat and down

phases.name: follow_through
phases.label: Follow-through
phases.cue: Drive the racket down through it

techniques.name: Bajada (off the back wall)
techniques.summary: Attacking overhead-style forehand after the lob rebounds off the back glass: stay sideways, let the ball drop to shoulder-to-head height and drive it down.

phases.name: preparation
phases.label: Turn and point
phases.cue: Turn with the ball off the glass

phases.name: racket_drop
phases.label: Racket drop
phases.cue: Racket drops as the ball comes down

phases.name: contact
phases.label: Contact
phases.cue: Hit beside the head, ball in front

techniques.name: Forehand drive
techniques.summary: Flat, compact forehand from the back of the court: early turn, short backswing, contact in front of the front foot at waist height.

phases.name: turn
phases.label: Unit turn
phases.cue: Unit turn: shoulders and racket together

phases.name: contact
phases.label: Contact
phases.cue: Contact in front of the front foot

techniques.name: Backhand drive
techniques.summary: One-handed padel backhand: free hand guides the take-back, contact in front of the front (right) foot, arm extends through the ball.

phases.name: turn
phases.label: Unit turn
phases.cue: Turn: right shoulder to the net

phases.name: backswing
phases.label: Backswing
phases.cue: Free hand on the throat, racket back

phases.name: contact
phases.label: Contact
phases.cue: Contact in front of the right foot

techniques.name: Forehand volley
techniques.summary: Short block-and-punch at the net: split step, small turn, contact in front with a slightly open face, no backswing.

phases.name: contact
phases.label: Contact
phases.cue: Punch in front, face slightly open

techniques.name: Backhand volley
techniques.summary: Backhand block at the net: free hand sets the racket, step across with the right foot, contact well in front.

phases.name: turn
phases.label: Short turn
phases.cue: Turn, free hand on the throat

techniques.name: Lob (globo)
techniques.summary: Defensive forehand lob: low-to-high swing with an open face, contact below the waist, long upward finish.

phases.name: forward_swing
phases.label: Racket drop
phases.cue: Racket head well below the ball

phases.name: contact
phases.label: Contact
phases.cue: Open face, lift under the ball

techniques.name: Chiquita
techniques.summary: Soft, low forehand to the feet of the net players: short swing, slightly open face, the ball dips just over the net.

phases.name: forward_swing
phases.label: Racket drop
phases.cue: Bend the knees, get under it

phases.name: follow_through
phases.label: Follow-through
phases.cue: Guide it low over the net

techniques.name: Back-wall exit (forehand)
techniques.summary: Salida de pared: let the ball come off the back glass, turn with it, and hit up and forward once it drops beside you.

phases.name: turn
phases.label: Unit turn
phases.cue: Turn with the ball off the wall

phases.name: forward_swing
phases.label: Racket drop
phases.cue: Drop the racket as the ball falls

phases.name: contact
phases.label: Contact
phases.cue: Contact beside you, below the waist

techniques.name: Padel serve
techniques.summary: Underhand serve: bounce the ball beside the front foot, compact forehand swing, contact at or below the waist.

phases.name: ready
phases.label: Ready
phases.cue: Set up sideways, ball in hand

phases.name: turn
phases.label: Unit turn
phases.cue: Drop the ball beside the front foot

phases.name: contact
phases.label: Contact
phases.cue: Contact at or below the waist
